header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2021 and was lastly fixed in the court on 24.08.2022, and even on that date none was present on behalf of the petitioner. Even thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

Perusal of the prayer clause reflects that the petitioner is seeking directions to the respondents Nos.2 to 5 in respect of prices of the flour in Dhoronaro, District Umerkot. The season for which the petition was filed has now been elapsed; therefore this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of.
